purpose: Explicit, reviewable contract of the validators that compose the hosted reference validation gate, satisfying STANDARDIZATION_READINESS_GATE.md section 5 (validation available in hosted CI or an equivalently reproducible release gate).

a_passing_gate_means: structural integrity of the declared artifacts
the declared validation contracts in this manifest are satisfied
a_passing_gate_does_not_mean: ASR is published (its clause text is licensed CC-BY-4.0 but ASR remains an unpublished Working Draft)
ASR clauses are canonical externally-citable objects (held by CITE-HOLD-ASR-001)

runtime.dependency_note: All 14 validate_*.py scripts import standard library only; validate_boundary_cases_v0_3.py, validate_corpus_application_v0_3.py, and validate_second_stratum.py import the sibling repo module validate_boundary_cases (not a PyPI package). No pinned third-party dependency is required.

registration_policy.rule: Every validate_*.py present in the repository root MUST appear in this manifest as a validator script. An unregistered validator causes gate failure; it is never silently ignored. Adding a new validator is therefore a deliberate governance act, not an automatic consequence of file discovery.

validators.invocation_note: Version-specific: this validator validates v0.1 profiles and correctly fails on v0.2 profiles. Invoked against the committed v0.1 synthetic profiles.
